story.iWant: to process a student's transition back to home campus with notifications
story.soThat: the return process is documented, tracked, and home campus admins are informed

acceptanceCriteria.ac: "Initiate Transition" available when status = 'met' | Button visible for eligible placements
Transition form captures meeting date | Date picker validates future date
Transition form captures campus contact person | Name field required
In-app notification created for home campus admins | Notification record(s) created for each campus_admin at home campus
"Complete Transition" requires meeting confirmation | Modal with meeting date display, checkbox required
"Complete Transition" requires first day back date | Date field required
Status moves to Complete after confirmation | Placement status updated to 'complete'
TrespassTracker is_daep flag updated on completion | Flag synced via syncTrespassTrackerStatus()
Transition history visible on student profile | Timeline shows transitions from daep_placement_transitions

constraints.nfr: All queries use RLS with tenant_id = get_my_tenant_id()
Notification insert failure doesn't block status update (log warning only)
All transitions logged to daep_placement_transitions and admin_audit_log
constraints.pattern: Use getTenantId() from lib/tenant.ts for all database queries
Use logAuditEvent() for all placement modifications
Use user_id field (NOT created_by) for notification recipient
Query user_profiles WHERE campus_id = home_campus_id AND role = 'campus_admin'
Always validate via isValidTransition() before status updates

tests.standards: Tests should follow existing patterns. Use Jest for unit tests, mock Supabase client for database operations.

devNotes.critical: The notification schema uses user_id for RECIPIENT, not created_by. The tech spec was corrected on 2025-11-30 to fix this bug. Always query home campus admins by: campus_id = home_campus_id AND role = 'campus_admin'
devNotes.workflow: Actual transition workflow (from architecture notes): 1. Status = 'met' (days complete) 2. Admin clicks "Initiate Transition" → schedules meeting 3. Notifications go to HOME CAMPUS ADMINS ONLY (not all campus admins) 4. Admin clicks "Complete Transition" → confirms meeting, enters first day back 5. Status = 'complete', TrespassTracker synced
devNotes.futureEnhancements: See docs/sprint-artifacts/daep/architecture-notes-daep-vs-trespass.md for: - Per-campus notification configuration - Role expansion (principal, AP, counselor) - Teacher grade report workflow - Document upload feature
